metric.definition: macro mean IoU over classes present in target or prediction, confusion matrix accumulated over the full validation split (torchmetrics multiclass JaccardIndex convention, as in geo-bench-experiments)
metric.name: miou

rationale: Selected using full validation only: mIoU improved from 0.6066 to 0.6683. Class 4 IoU improved from 0.2291 to 0.3709, and class 6 from 0.0476 to 0.2898. Best checkpoint is epoch 28. No test results used.
